notes: Scout 2026-11-26: read the finnsranch.com homepage, About Us, FAQs, Home Delivery, Neighborhood Pickup, Farmers Markets, Find Us (locations), Farm pickup location, Contact, and store pages for beef, beef bulk, lamb/goat, pork, poultry and fish, all through WebFetch summaries, so the quote came from a summary; Verifier: recheck exact wording. Farm is at 13559 Coveney Road, Buchanan, but sells mainly to Chicagoland: Wednesday home delivery in Cook and DuPage counties ($15, free over $200, $35 minimum), neighborhood pickup, and farm pickup Sundays 8am to noon (porch cooler). FAQ says it does not ship. Farmers markets are described only as various markets throughout Chicagoland; the names were in an image or not on the pages, so none are listed. Bulk beef page exists but said no products currently available, so bulk_shares left false. Lamb page says raised on open pastures; pork and poultry are pasture-raised, chicken feed includes non-GMO corn and soy. Goat category had no goat products. Site does not say whether lamb or pork are raised on the farm or bought in; About page photos show sheep, goats and pigs. Banner: last delivery December 16 before an end-of-year break.
